name: bomomby/optick
description: A super-lightweight C++ profiler for games providing instrumentation, context switching, sampling, and GPU counters. Features a standalone viewer and supports Direct3D 12 and Vulkan GPU profiling.
score_rationale: 3.1k stars, MIT, popular lightweight game profiler used in commercial engines with good cross-platform support.
summary: Embeddable CPU/GPU profiler with standalone viewer for game optimization
